title: PowerPoint: edit presentations with Copilot in the DoD cloud
summary: The roadmap facts, government licensing requirements and licence-management instructions are supported. The briefing correctly reports the disagreement over DoD availability; its statement about multi-slide editing needs a citation to Microsoft's PowerPoint support page.
